about: Guide listings for channels your provider's own guide leaves out. THE ONE PLACE to add one: put its XMLTV link under guides (or add a channel to a guide already here), then push; every GarysTV picks it up at its next update. 'guideId' is the <channel id> in that XMLTV file; 'match' are words in your channel's name (any of them, ignoring case and punctuation) and 'except' words that rule a channel out. Only the listed channels are kept from each file, so a big file costs a download, not guide space.
